purpose: Required timestamp fields and rules for any future P4 acceptance-event implementation. Infrastructure contract only; scientific acceptance research is NOT yet implemented.
consumption_rule: an acceptance event is consumable ONLY at acceptance_known_time; never earlier
prohibitions: no backdating: an event may not be marked accepted on a bar before its evidence is complete
no post-hoc acceptance used as an entry signal

touch_A0.state_event_time: bar at which price touches/breaches the boundary
touch_A0.acceptance_known_time: same bar close / next bar open

close_A1.state_event_time: bar at which price first closes beyond the boundary

occupancy_A2.note: 3-of-last-4 occupancy cannot be marked accepted on the first bar
occupancy_A2.state_event_time: first bar of the qualifying window
occupancy_A2.evidence_complete_time: bar at which the Nth-of-M occupancy condition is met

persistence_A3.note: persistence requiring N surviving bars cannot be backdated
persistence_A3.evidence_complete_time: bar at which the Nth survival bar closes

retest_A4.note: retest acceptance cannot be backdated to the initial breakout

validation: src/mve/causality.validate_acceptance_events() enforces field presence and ordering; tested in tests/mve/test_causality.py::test_acceptance_schema_validation
